findings.evidence: Lines 36–41 explicitly cite “Layer 2,” the “Definition milestone,” the roadmap API checklist, and a pinned signature.
findings.fix: Remove lines 36–41 and retain the Ribes–Zalesskii citation; keep roadmap attribution in the PR description.
findings.issue: The module docstring embeds roadmap layer, milestone, checklist, and `Suggested.lean` coordination details, which are process metadata rather than a mathematical reference.

findings.evidence: `IsProPSylow` at lines 57–60 has no compactness assumption, while Mathlib defines `OpenNormalSubgroup` only as an open normal subgroup (`Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/OpenSubgroup.lean:368`).
findings.fix: Describe these as quotients by open normal subgroups, or restrict the declarations before calling them finite continuous quotients.
findings.issue: Lines 16, 51–53, and 81–82 call every quotient indexed by `OpenNormalSubgroup G` finite, although the declarations assume only `[Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]`; an open normal subgroup need not have finite index without compactness.

findings.evidence: Lines 127–134 have only `[DiscreteTopology G]`, and lines 151–154 add `[Q.FiniteIndex]`; `[Finite G]` first appears at line 156.
findings.fix: Describe the criterion as applying to discrete groups and `Sylow.isProPSylow` as applying to finite-index Sylow subgroups; reserve “finite discrete group” for declarations after `[Finite G]`.
findings.issue: The criterion is documented at lines 30 and 130 as a finite-discrete specialization, but `isProPSylow_iff_isPGroup_and_not_dvd_index` assumes only `[DiscreteTopology G]`; line 31 also calls `Sylow.isProPSylow` a finite Sylow result although it assumes finite index, not finite `G` or finite `Q`.

summary: The documentation contains roadmap/process material and repeatedly misstates the scope of quotient and discrete-group results.
